UnitStatement: CLAUDE.md provides guidance to Claude Code when working with code in this repository.
Chirality is a filesystem-native agent operating system for deliverable-heavy professional work.
The repository contains the private canonical source tree for Chirality.
The private canonical source tree contains instruction architecture, agent contracts, skills, deterministic tools, domain workspaces, and public-package tooling.
Chirality tooling produces the sanitized public `chirality-app` package.
The core Chirality design principle is that the filesystem is the database.
Authoritative project state lives in git-tracked plain files.
Agents propose and humans decide.
No agent may certify, approve, sign, or issue work for reliance.
Orientation starts with `INIT.md` as the bootstrap and document map.
`AGENTS.md` is the agent index, matrix, and governance integration rules reference.
`docs/DIRECTIVE.md` contains the founding philosophy.
`docs/SPEC.md` defines physical structures, file formats, and folder layouts.
`docs/TYPES.md` defines stable IDs, enums, and lifecycle states.
`docs/CONTRACT.md` contains the 21 K-* binding invariants.
`skills/README.md` contains the skill system contract.
`tools/REGISTRY.md` is the deterministic tool index.
Type 0 agents are canonical standards.
Type 1 agents are interactive personas that open in WORKBENCH.
Type 2 agents are bounded task shells that open in PIPELINE.
`TASK` is the canonical Type 2 execution shell.
`TASK` hydrates skills via `TaskSkill: <name>`.
Skills are method packs for recurring task shapes.
A skill is used when role, write scope, and interaction model stay the same but the method changes.
A new agent should not be created when a skill covers the role, write scope, and interaction model.
Skills live under `skills/<name>/`.
Each skill requires `SKILL.md`, `BRIEF_SCHEMA.md`, `TOOL_POLICY.md`, and `QA_CHECKS.md`.
A derivative package is assembled from accepted upstream truth.
Derivative packages must cite their upstream snapshot.
Derivative packages must never substitute for decomposition truth.
Every phase-boundary decision must produce an immutable snapshot.
Later phases consume accepted snapshots instead of mutable working state.
Agents have explicit, bounded write scopes.
Skills must never widen scope beyond what the agent shell and brief allow.
Claims carry `FACT`, `ASSUMPTION`, `PROPOSAL`, or `TBD` labels.
`TBD` markers are surfaced, not silently resolved.
Agent instructions are rooted at `AGENTS.md` and `agents/AGENT_*.md`.
Agent instructions change through the live registry, not narrative.
Skills are rooted at `skills/`.
Each immediate `skills/` subfolder containing `SKILL.md` is treated as one skill.
The live skill folder is treated as the skill index.
Tools are rooted at `tools/`.
`tools/REGISTRY.md` is the tool registry.
Tool subfolders group tools by function.
`frontend/` is a public-export snapshot only.
Frontend development work goes in `projects/chirality-app-dev/`.
Domain workspaces are rooted at `domains/`.
Large corpora in domain workspaces are excluded from git.
Project workspaces are rooted at `projects/`.
Project workspaces are private and not exported.
`exports/chirality-app/` controls what goes into the public package.
`plans/` and `.archive/` are non-governing historical context.
After skill changes, run `python3 tools/validation/validate_skill_metadata.py skills`.
Test surfaces are discovered with `python3 tools/validation/discover_test_surfaces.py . --text`.
Root tool Python tests are run with `python3 -m pytest -q tools`.
Chirality App dev frontend tests are run from `projects/chirality-app-dev/frontend` with `npm test`.
OpenPipeStress Python tests are run from `projects/chirality-piping` with `python3 -m pytest -q tests`.
OpenPipeStress desktop tests are run with `npm test --workspace apps/desktop` from `projects/chirality-piping`.
OpenPipeStress Rust tests are run per crate with `cargo test --manifest-path <crate>/Cargo.toml`.
The public export is built and checked with `python3 exports/chirality-app/export_public.py`.
The public export is applied to a local checkout with `python3 exports/chirality-app/export_public.py --apply-target /path/to/chirality-app`.
Frontend development commands are run from the `frontend` directory.
Frontend dependencies are installed with `npm install`.
The Next.js dev server starts with `npm run dev`.
The frontend production build runs with `npm run build`.
Frontend ESLint runs with `npm run lint`.
The Electron desktop app runs in dev mode with `npm run desktop:dev`.
The Electron app is packaged without publishing by `npm run desktop:pack`.
The signed distributable is built with `npm run desktop:dist`.
The unsigned local-testing distributable is built with `npm run desktop:dist:unsigned`.
The frontend dev server shell requires `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`.
Harness validation before merge requires the server to be running first.
The pre-merge harness server command runs `npm run dev -- --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 3000` from `frontend`.
The harness validation shell runs from the `frontend` directory.
Toolkit harness validation runs with `npm run harness:validate:toolkit`.
Pre-merge harness validation runs with `npm run harness:validate:premerge`.
The harness validation summary artifact is `frontend/artifacts/harness/section8/latest/summary.json`.
Harness diagnostics log to `.chirality/logs/harness.log` in the project root.
The Electron app bundles `agents/`, `skills/`, `tools/`, `docs/`, and `init/` as `extraResources` under `instruction-root/`.
Agent and routing changes go through `AGENTS.md` and `agents/`.
Skill changes go through `skills/` and then run `validate_skill_metadata.py`.
Tool changes go through `tools/` and update `tools/REGISTRY.md` when the curated tool contract changes.
Governance changes go through root `docs/`, not project-local docs.
App and frontend development goes through `projects/chirality-app-dev/`.
Reviewed app and frontend material is promoted only to root and export surfaces.
Public export changes require regenerating the manifest after changing exported files.
When live folders, indexes, and narrative documents disagree, the live registry/discovery surface is authoritative.
Registry discrepancies must be surfaced rather than silently preserving stale prose.
The full set of 21 K-* invariants is in `docs/CONTRACT.md`.
`K-AUTH-1` states that only humans author binding approval records.
`K-WRITE-1` and `K-SNAP-1` pair explicit write scope with phase-boundary immutable snapshots.
`K-PROV-1` requires provenance for all governed claims.
Unsourced assertions are marked `TBD` or `ASSUMPTION`, not silently asserted as fact.
`K-STATUS-1` makes `_STATUS.md` the canonical lifecycle state file for each deliverable.
No file other than `_STATUS.md` determines deliverable state.
`K-HIER-1` states that projects decompose as flat packages containing deliverables.
